passives.name: Awe
passives.description: Gain bonus health equal to 8% of your maximum mana.

passives.name: Everlasting
passives.description: Slowing or immobilizing an enemy champion shields you for 100-180 (by level) + 4.5% of your current mana for 3s. The shield is 80% stronger if more than one enemy champion is within 1000 range (8s cooldown).
